title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: waiver conditions that also bind a late-invoice clearance
content:
## Scope

Under the AHL Demurrage and Detention Free Time category, a late-invoice clearance of a demurrage invoice line is itself a waiver entry on the per-container record. This rule states the waiver conditions it must also meet.

## Rule

Being a waiver entry, a late-invoice waiver is also subject to the goodwill waiver conditions that apply to every waiver entry:

1. the customer's commercial goodwill waivers in the trailing 365 days must be fewer than the product's trailing-year goodwill allowance;
2. the waiver must fall within the product's goodwill request window of the invoice date;
3. the line must carry no earlier commercial goodwill waiver.

## Checklist

| Condition | Holds when |
|---|---|
| Trailing-year allowance | the customer's commercial goodwill waivers in the trailing 365 days are fewer than the product allows |
| Request window | the waiver date is not later than the invoice date plus the product's request window |
| Earlier goodwill on the line | there is none |

## Worked cases (hypothetical allowance of 1 and window of 20 days)

- The customer received no commercial goodwill waiver in the trailing 365 days, the line was invoiced on 2 March and the clearance falls on 20 March, and no goodwill was ever granted on the line: all three conditions hold.
- The same line, but the customer already received 1 commercial goodwill waiver in the trailing 365 days: 1 is not fewer than 1, so the condition fails.
- The same line, but a commercial goodwill waiver was earlier booked against it: the third condition fails.
